The structure we study in this work is thePT-symmetric trilayer with the isotropic outer layers and the magneto-optic material sandwiched between them (see Fig. 1).
To study light propagation inside the multilayered structures, we use the operator transfer-matrix method described in Refs. [51, 53].
CLM-PHOT-0084.statement: The thickness d of each layer in the PT-symmetric trilayer structure is 3 µm unless otherwise stated.

extra_quotes: To study light propagation inside the multilayered structures, we use the operator transfer-matrix method described in Refs. [51, 53].

We consider only the magnetic fields oriented along the z axis, whereas in realistic situations it can be directed arbitrarily. A more detailed analysis with the permittivity tensor having other nondiagonal elements is needed to fully describe the general situation.
